rounds.text: The stock is priced aggressively at an all-time high, trading right at 100% of its 52-week range [E42, E43] with a rich price-to-book multiple of 8.40x [E2] and a P/E of 27.3 [E1]. Expectations are running excessively ahead of fundamentals, as price growth has outpaced profit growth both over a 5-year span and in the recent period [E50, E51], leaving the valuation vulnerable to any deceleration. Beneath the surface momentum, borrowing has spiked significantly to Rs 61 Cr in March 2026 from just Rs 4 Cr a year earlier [E33], coinciding with the acquisition of Unbound Medicine [E71, E78]. Furthermore, this capital deployment and an active M&A pipeline forced the Board to withhold a final dividend for FY26 [E79], breaking income expectations for shareholders despite historical yields [E4]. Adding to the structural risk, historical trading patterns reveal a catastrophic peak-to-trough drawdown of -93.1% [E47], alongside a notable flight of institutional capital as foreign institutional holdings dropped from 3.80% in September 2023 to 1.38% in June 2026 [E36]. Conceded: [E39], [E55].
